description_en: Counts the total number of node groups that match the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 调用CountNodeGroups统计符合过滤条件的节点分组总数
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan count-node-groups --iot-instance-id iot-060a09wy --fuzzy-name group1 --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountNodeGroups

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value exists for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The node group name for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by nodes in the node group for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组中节点所使用的 JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI of nodes in the node group for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组中节点的 DevEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

Data.description_en: The total number of node groups that match the filter conditions
Data.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的节点分组总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
